g.title: frag_micro_nn_distance → frag_meso_contact_component_count upward 局部最近邻间距改变鱼之间形成接触边的概率：当许多鱼彼此远离时，原生接触图更易断开，从而增加连通分量数；该关系依赖空间排布而非由定义直接决定。
frag_micro_nn_distance → frag_macro_largest_component_fraction upward 个体局部间距增大会削弱跨邻域接触链，使最大连通分量占比可能下降；但若存在少数稠密核心，影响可被缓冲，因此不是确定性聚合。
frag_meso_contact_component_count → frag_macro_largest_component_fraction upward 鱼群分裂为更多连通分量时，最大分量占比通常可能降低；但多分量可包含一个主导核心，故这是动态结构候选而非代数恒等。
elong_micro_axis_alignment → elong_meso_local_eigen_ratio upward 个体朝向与群体主轴对齐会通过定向运动改变局部接触邻域的空间排布，使相邻鱼的位置协方差沿运动方向更易拉伸；局部邻域组成和转向限制使该效应非确定。
elong_micro_axis_alignment → elong_macro_global_eigen_ratio upward 大量个体沿群体主轴对齐时，定向游动可能累积为整体位置分布的各向异性拉伸；个体转向上限和随机扰动使对齐不必然转化为等比例全局拉伸。
elong_meso_local_eigen_ratio → elong_macro_global_eigen_ratio upward 若多个局部接触邻域同时沿相近方向拉长，它们的空间各向异性可汇聚成全局伸长；若局部主轴方向分散则可能相互抵消，因此不是简单求和定义。

g.title: N1 | frag_micro_nn_distance Focal fish nearest-neighbor distance Scale: micro | Phenomenon: school_fragmentation Definition: For run r and step t, let V_t={i: role_i(t)='fish'}. For i in V_t, d_i(t)=min_{j in V_t, j!=i} sqrt((x_i(t)-x_j(t))^2+(y_i(t)-y_j(t))^2). If |V_t|<2, d_i(t)=NaN. Execution: {'2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5': {'status': 'success', 'series_file': 'indicator_series/2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5/frag_micro_nn_distance.parquet', 'series_sha256': '3b312a81989834692e765b861953bf4b9777d72a81fc4c895e38399e387bb2c4'}}

N2 | frag_meso_contact_component_count Fish contact-graph component count Scale: meso | Phenomenon: school_fragmentation Definition: At (r,t), build G_t=(V_t,E_t) with V_t={i: role_i(t)='fish'} and E_t={{i,j}: i,j in V_t, i!=j, and (agent_id=i, partner_id=j) or (agent_id=j, partner_id=i) appears in contacts at (r,t)}. Let C_1(t),...,C_{K(t)}(t) be the connected components of G_t. K(t)=number of components. Execution: {'2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5': {'status': 'success', 'series_file': 'indicator_series/2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5/frag_meso_contact_component_count.parquet', 'series_sha256': '4cf060754c76c46cddf0dad5ff306bca23e6bc940786dc3b57db2221359e5811'}}

N3 | frag_macro_largest_component_fraction Largest fish contact-component fraction Scale: macro | Phenomenon: school_fragmentation Definition: Using G_t and components C_k(t) from the contact graph at (r,t), L(t)=max_k |C_k(t)|/|V_t|, with L(t)=NaN if |V_t|=0. Execution: {'2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5': {'status': 'success', 'series_file': 'indicator_series/2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5/frag_macro_largest_component_fraction.parquet', 'series_sha256': 'af054b1af64809a55d82042106e5256b6011bcf86158bf17e0519d738b10a0ba'}}

N4 | elong_micro_axis_alignment Focal fish heading alignment with group principal axis Scale: micro | Phenomenon: school_elongation Definition: For run r and step t, let V_t={i: role_i(t)='fish'}. Let mu(t)=(1/|V_t|) sum_{j in V_t} p_j(t) and Sigma(t)=(1/(|V_t|-1)) sum_{j in V_t} (p_j(t)-mu(t))(p_j(t)-mu(t))^T with p_j=(x_j,y_j). Let lambda1>=lambda2 be eigenvalues of Sigma(t) and u1(t) a unit eigenvector for lambda1. For i in V_t, h_i(t)=(cos heading_i(t), sin heading_i(t)); a_i(t)=|h_i(t) dot u1(t)|. If |V_t|<3 or lambda1=lambda2, set a_i(t)=NaN. Execution: {'2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5': {'status': 'success', 'series_file': 'indicator_series/2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5/elong_micro_axis_alignment.parquet', 'series_sha256': '42ac8d51aeba9ef44e2d72ab20454b4af12dac3ef6056aec2a23c1cfd979cdcc'}}
